prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic studio portrait of an original approved adult East Asian cosplay model against a clean white background.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman in her early twenties with long pink twin-tails fading to blue tips, two thick braids, sparkling eyes, soft blush, and delicate makeup wears an intricate black-and-white maid outfit with oversized ruffled collar, puffed sleeves, corset-style bodice, black bow, lace trim, apron, and layered frilled skirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered vertical portrait, head-to-waist fashion framing, strong focus on pink braided hair, white lace headpiece, individual hair strands, lace and fabric texture, monochrome outfit details, and a pure white minimalist studio background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused even studio light, gentle highlights on hair and lace, clean high-end catalog atmosphere, natural skin pores without plastic smoothing.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic vertical 2:3 portrait photography, 85mm lens perspective, shallow but controlled depth of field, sharp hair and garment detail, subtle natural grain, restrained color, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 2:3 studio portrait of an original approved adult East Asian woman in her early twenties with long pink twin-tails fading to blue tips, two thick braids, sparkling eyes, soft blush, and delicate makeup. She wears an intricate black-and-white maid outfit with an oversized ruffled collar, puffed sleeves, corset-style bodice, black bow, lace trim, white apron, and layered frilled skirt, plus a white lace headpiece. Centered clean white background, soft diffused even lighting, sharp individual hair strands and realistic lace texture, natural skin pores, refined cosplay portrait.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, unreadable text
